## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(sfnetworks)
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)

resumen_perga <- tibble(
  red = "Pergamino (Componente Principal)",
  nodos = igraph::gorder(perganet_clean),
  ejes = igraph::gsize(perganet_clean),
  longitud_km = perganet_clean |> 
    activate("edges") |> 
    as_tibble() |> 
    pull(edge_length()) |> 
    sum(na.rm = TRUE) |> 
    units::set_units("m") |> 
    units::set_units("km") |> 
    as.numeric() |> 
    round(2),
  grado_medio = mean(igraph::degree(perganet_clean)) |> round(2),
  densidad = igraph::edge_density(perganet_clean) |> round(6)
)
```

```{r}


resumen_perga <- tibble(
  red = "Pergamino (Componente Principal)",
  nodos = igraph::gorder(perganet_clean),
  ejes = igraph::gsize(perganet_clean),
  
  # Corrección para extraer la longitud total sin el error de edge_length()
  longitud_km = perganet_clean |> 
    activate("edges") |> 
    as_tibble() |> 
    mutate(len = st_length(geometry)) |> 
    pull(len) |> 
    sum(na.rm = TRUE) |> 
    units::set_units("m") |> 
    units::set_units("km") |> 
    as.numeric() |> 
    round(2),
  
  grado_medio = mean(igraph::degree(perganet_clean)) |> round(2),
  densidad = igraph::edge_density(perganet_clean) |> round(6)
)
```

```{perganet_time <- perganet_blend |>}
  activate("edges") |>
  mutate(
    speed_kmh = case_when(
      !is.na(maxspeed_imp) ~ maxspeed_imp,
      TRUE                 ~ 40
    ),
    # Conversión física y cálculo de peso en minutos para igraph
    speed    = set_units(set_units(speed_kmh, "km/h"), "m/s"),
    time_sec = edge_length() / speed,
    weight   = drop_units(set_units(time_sec, "minutes"))
  ) |>
  select(geometry, weight, maxspeed_imp) |>
  activate("nodes")
```

```{r}
perganet_time <- perganet_blend |>
  activate("edges") |>
  mutate(
    # 1. Aseguramos conservar la distancia métrica original en una columna propia
    dist_m = edge_length(),
    weight_mts = drop_units(dist_m), # Por si necesitabas metros limpios
    
    # 2. Definimos velocidad base
    speed_kmh = case_when(
      !is.na(maxspeed_imp) ~ maxspeed_imp,
      TRUE                 ~ 40
    ),
    speed = units::set_units(speed_kmh, "km/h"),
    speed = units::set_units(speed, "m/s"),
    
    # 3. Calculamos el tiempo en minutos
    time_sec = dist_m / speed,                               # Segundos
    time_min = units::set_units(time_sec, "minutes"),        # Minutos
    weight_time = units::drop_units(time_min)                # NUEVA columna exclusiva de tiempo
  ) |>
  # Seleccionamos las geometrías y AMBOS pesos para no perder nada
  select(geometry, weight_mts, weight_time, maxspeed_imp) |>
  activate("nodes")
```

```{r}
perganet_time <- perganet_blend |>
  activate("edges") |>
  mutate(
    # 1. Definimos velocidad base (con tu case_when o maxspeed_imp)
    speed_kmh = case_when(
      !is.na(maxspeed_imp) ~ maxspeed_imp,
      TRUE                 ~ 40
    ),
    speed  = units::set_units(speed_kmh, "km/h"), #como el dato esta plano le etiquetamos una unidad para despues pasarla a la que necesitamos que es metros por segundo
    speed  = units::set_units(speed, "m/s"),
    dist_m = edge_length(),
    time   = weight / speed,         # Resultado en segundos (m / (m/s)) porque los metros se anulan automaticamente
    time   = units::set_units(time, "minutes"),# Lo pasamos a minutos
    time   = units::drop_units(time),          # Quitamos unidades para igraph
    
    # 4. Asignamos ese 'time' limpio al 'weight' que exige la red
    weight = time
  ) |>
  select(geometry, weight, maxspeed_imp) |>
  activate("nodes")


```

```{r}
library(tidygraph)
library(sfnetworks)

# Cálculo de centralidades sobre la red ponderada por tiempo y distancia
perganet_centrality <- perganet_time |>
  activate("nodes") |>
  mutate(
    degree        = centrality_degree(mode = "in"),
    closeness_t   = centrality_closeness(weights = time, normalized = TRUE),
    closeness_mts = centrality_closeness(weights = weight, normalized = TRUE),
    betweenness_t = centrality_betweenness(weights = time, normalized = TRUE),
    betweenness_mts = centrality_betweenness(weights = weight, normalized = TRUE)
  ) |>
  activate("edges") |>
  mutate(
    edge_flow = centrality_edge_betweenness(weights = time, directed = TRUE)
  ) |>
  activate("nodes")
```

```{r}

# 1. Extraemos los nodos de tu red métrica con sus valores
nodos_mts <- st_as_sf(perganet_metrics_mts, "nodes")

# 2. Suponiendo que tenés tus POIs cargados en un objeto espacial llamado 'pois' 
# (o podés filtrar por cercanía espacial a las coordenadas de cada punto clave):
# Vamos a hacer un "spatial join" para cruzar tus POIs con los nodos de la red centralizada:

pois_con_centralidad <- st_join(pois, nodos_mts, join = st_nearest_feature)

# 3. Seleccionamos y mostramos la tablita limpia en consola
tabla_pois_mts <- pois_con_centralidad |>
  select(nombre_poi, degree, closeness_mts, betweenness_mts)

print(tabla_pois_mts)
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(sfnetworks)
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(units)

# 1. Construimos la red temporal usando correctamente el campo maxspeed_imp con sus valores reales
perganet_time <- perganet_blend |>
  activate("edges") |>
  mutate(
    # Si hay velocidad la usa; si es NA, por defecto le asigna 40 km/h
    speed_kmh = case_when(
      !is.na(maxspeed_imp) ~ maxspeed_imp,
      TRUE                 ~ 40
    ),
    speed = set_units(speed_kmh, "km/h"),
    speed = set_units(speed, "m/s"),
    
    # Calculamos tiempo real en minutos
    dist_m = edge_length(),
    time_sec = dist_m / speed,
    time_min = set_units(time_sec, "minutes"),
    
    # Guardamos el peso temporal limpio (sin unidades)
    weight_time = drop_units(time_min)
  ) |>
  select(geometry, weight, weight_time, maxspeed_imp) |>
  activate("nodes")

# 2. Calculamos las centralidades métricas (en metros)
perganet_metrics_mts <- perganet_blend |>
  activate("nodes") |>
  mutate(
    degree           = centrality_degree(mode = "in"),
    closeness_mts    = centrality_closeness(weights = weight, normalized = TRUE),
    betweenness_mts  = centrality_betweenness(weights = weight, normalized = TRUE)
  ) |>
  activate("nodes")

# 3. Calculamos las centralidades temporales (en minutos, usando weight_time)
perganet_timetrics <- perganet_time |>
  activate("nodes") |>
  mutate(
    degree           = centrality_degree(mode = "in"),
    closeness_time   = centrality_closeness(weights = weight_time, normalized = TRUE),
    betweenness_time = centrality_betweenness(weights = weight_time, normalized = TRUE)
  ) |>
  activate("edges") |>
  mutate(
    edge_flow        = centrality_edge_betweenness(weights = weight_time, directed = TRUE)
  ) |>
  activate("nodes")
```

```{r}
tabla_centralizacion_global <- tibble(

  Centr_Grado = c(
    igraph::centr_degree(as.igraph(perganet_metrics_mts))$centralization |> round(4),
    igraph::centr_degree(as.igraph(perganet_timetrics))$centralization |> round(4)
  ),
  Centr_Intermediacion = c(
    igraph::centr_betw(as.igraph(perganet_metrics_mts), directed = TRUE, weights = E(as.igraph(perganet_metrics_mts))$weight)$centralization |> round(4),
    igraph::centr_betw(as.igraph(perganet_timetrics), directed = TRUE, weights = E(as.igraph(perganet_timetrics))$weight_time)$centralization |> round(4)
  ),
  Centr_Cercania = c(
    igraph::centr_clo(as.igraph(perganet_metrics_mts))$centralization |> round(4),
    igraph::centr_clo(as.igraph(perganet_timetrics))$centralization |> round(4)
  )
)

print(tabla_centralizacion_global)
```

```{r}
  activate("nodes") |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(nodo = row_number()) |>
  select(
    nodo,

    closeness_mts,
    betweenness_mts
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(betweenness_mts))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

tabla_max_centralidad_mts <- bind_rows(
  
  tabla_nodos_mts |>
    slice_max(degree, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) |>
    transmute(
      Indicador = "Grado",
      Nodo = nodo,
      Valor = degree
    ),
  
  tabla_nodos_mts |>
    slice_max(closeness_mts, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) |>
    transmute(
      Indicador = "Cercanía",
      Nodo = nodo,
      Valor = closeness_mts
    ),
  
  tabla_nodos_mts |>
    slice_max(betweenness_mts, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) |>
    transmute(
      Indicador = "Intermediación",
      Nodo = nodo,
      Valor = betweenness_mts
    )
)

tabla_max_centralidad_mts
```

```{r}
              geom_sf(

              scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno") +

              guides(size = "none") +

                legend.position = "bottom",

              )

)
```

```{r}

nodos_sf <- perganet_metrics |>
  activate("nodes") |>
  st_as_sf()

# Área de estudio a partir de los nodos
area_estudio <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(nodos_sf))

# Grilla hexagonal de 500 metros
grilla_hex_geom <- st_make_grid(
  area_estudio,
  cellsize = 500,
  square = FALSE
)

grilla_hex <- st_sf(
  zona_id = seq_along(grilla_hex_geom),
  geometry = grilla_hex_geom
)

st_crs(nodos_sf)
st_crs(grilla_hex)
nrow(grilla_hex)
```


```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = grilla_hex, fill = NA, color = "grey70") +
  geom_sf(data = nodos_sf, color = "red", size = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Grilla hexagonal de 500 m sobre la red vial de Pergamino") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

nodos_grilla <- st_join(
  nodos_sf,
  grilla_hex["zona_id"],
  join = st_within,
  left = TRUE
)

nrow(nodos_sf)
nrow(nodos_grilla)

sum(is.na(nodos_grilla$zona_id))
```

```{r}
sin_zona <- nodos_grilla |>
  filter(is.na(zona_id))

candidatas <- st_intersects(sin_zona, grilla_hex)

table(lengths(candidatas))

```

```{r}
resumen_hex <- nodos_grilla |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(zona_id) |>
  summarise(
    centralidad = mean(betweenness_mts, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nodos = n()
  )

grilla_final <- grilla_hex |>
  left_join(resumen_hex, by = "zona_id") |>
  mutate(
    quintil = if_else(
      !is.na(centralidad),
      ntile(centralidad, 5),
      NA_integer_
    )
  )
grilla_final |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(quintil) |>
  mutate(porcentaje = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2))
```
